# POST /api/v1/admin/users/{username}/badges

Add badges to a user by slug

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-121`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `UserBadgeOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `badge_slugs` | []string | True | binding:Required |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Not a site admin
- **500** — Badge slug not found or already assigned

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [services](../modules/services.md) | context.UserAssignmentAPI | controller | Resolve username to User |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.AddUserBadges | controller | Parse form body; Convert slugs to Badge structs; Call user_model.AddUserBadges |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | user_model.AddUserBadges | repository | Within transaction: for each badge slug, SELECT badge by slug, check EXISTS user_badge, INSERT user_badge |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| All admin endpoints require site admin privileges via reqSiteAdmin() middleware | authorization | tokenRequiresScopes(AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin), reqToken(), reqSiteAdmin() |
| AddUserBadges fails if badge slug does not exist in badge table | business_logic | !has (badge not found by slug) |
| AddUserBadges fails if user already has the badge | business_logic | exists (user_badge already exists for badge_id + user_id) |

### Error Paths

- **User not found** → UserAssignmentAPI → 404
- **Badge slug not found** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
- **User badge already exists** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
